description: Use this when the user asks to add UAE VAT to an amount, how much VAT is inside a VAT-inclusive price, or what the VAT is on a reverse-charge supply ("add VAT to 12,500", "how much VAT is in 1,050 AED"). Works out UAE VAT (5%) for one or more amounts. By default amounts are net and VAT is added. Set amounts_include_vat when the amounts already include VAT, to extract it. Set reverse_charge for a supply where the recipient accounts for the VAT (no VAT on the invoice; the result says how much VAT the recipient self-accounts). Each line can be standard (5%), zero, exempt or out_of_scope; lines are rounded to 2 decimals first and the totals are the sum of the lines. Do not use it for whether a supply is zero-rated or exempt (check_vat_on_supply) or for VAT figures from the user's own records (get_vat_summary).

amount.description: A single amount. Use lines instead for several amounts.

amounts_include_vat.description: true when the amounts already include VAT.

name: calculate_vat
title: Calculate UAE VAT
